test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The HCF of 1.75, 5.6 and 7 is :
solution:
Formula used:

HCF = HCF of numerator / LCM of denominator

Calculation:

⇒ 1.75 = 175/100 = 7/4

⇒ 5.6 = 56/10 = 28/5

⇒ 7/1

HCF = HCF of numerator / LCM of denominator

⇒ (HCF of 7, 28, and 7) / LCM of 4, 5 and 1

⇒ 7/20

⇒ 3.5/10

⇒ 0.35
